title: Statement-Age Points — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Hardship Assistance
content:
Statement-age points are added to the hardship assistance percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account whose hardship approval is in force, according to the statements issued on the account fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling date.

| Statements issued on the account in the window | Points added |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 3¹ |
| at least 3 but fewer than 5 | 1² |
| fewer than 3 | 0 |

¹ A count of exactly 5 earns 3 points.
² A count of 3 or 4 earns 1 point; a count of 2 earns none.

Notes to the table:

- Every patient statement issued on this coverage account counts, whatever balance it printed.
- A statement issued 6 whole calendar months or more before the handling date is outside the window; one issued 5 whole months before is inside.
- The points are percentage points of the assistance percentage itself, which is applied once to the charge; they are not a separate discount.

Hypothetical illustration: an account statemented monthly for the last eight months, with the handling date falling a few days after the latest statement, shows 6 statements issued fewer than 6 whole months before the handling date and earns 3 points.
